bio: Susannah Thompson was born on 17 August 1712, the daughter of Samuel Thompson and Hannah Brewster and a granddaughter of John Thompson of Setauket, John's 11th-great-grandfather; she is therefore John's 1st cousin 10 times removed. On 16 August 1734 she married Thomas Strong. Their children were Selah, Abigail, Submit, Ruth, Mary, Susannah, Zipporah, Hannah and Katurah. She died on 5 March 1788.
sources: [R4-S1] B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/historyoflongisl003thom
